I believe this can be work-rounded but:
- this workaround would abuse tree item selection (like wait for selecting a row and then select other columns of that item) which  might cause some issues
- I think having `Multi Row` mode is the logical conclusion of the selection modes, because all these 4 modes could be represented by 2 checkboxes/abilities:
1) ability to select multiple columns
2) ability to select multiple rows

So I think the proposed mode is a "missing link"
